headline: Highest risk is data leakage: cognee handles personal/finance data and transmits via allowlisted egress, while botpress lacks documented isolation or data-flow controls.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Botpress has no documented shared channel or output ingestion path, while cognee is documented with session memory and CLI tooling but no direct bridge to botpress. A prompt-injection pathway is therefore possible only if an operator manually connects outputs or copies content between them; the pairwise interaction is not directly documented, so uncertainty stays low rather than none.
conditions: IF an operator manually copies botpress output into cognee prompts or files, injection becomes plausible.
IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or message queue is introduced between the agents, the risk increases.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate workspaces.
Disable copy-paste of untrusted botpress output into cognee inputs.
Add a human review step before any cross-agent transfer.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to all transferred content.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Cognee explicitly touches personal data, finance data, and support history, and it has allowlisted network egress plus API-based I/O surfaces. Botpress is a customer-support agent with no documented isolation or data-handling limits beyond no network egress. If they share a workspace or operator workflow, sensitive support data can flow into cognee and then out through its networked backend.
conditions: IF botpress and cognee share a workspace or exported files, sensitive support data can cross between them.
IF cognee sends transferred content to its backend APIs, the data leaves the local boundary.
mitigations: Separate storage locations for each agent.
Restrict cognee inputs to redacted samples.
Review outbound API destinations in cognee.
Turn off any automatic export of botpress transcripts.
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent data-loss-prevention rules.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Botpress documents package installation but no write or network egress, while cognee supports multiple instances with session memory and allowlisted egress. There is no documented shared mutable resource or overlapping write scope, so direct capability conflict is limited. Uncertainty remains because botpress filesystem surfaces are not described, so the safer choice is low rather than none.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same mutable directory or database, write conflicts become plausible.
IF botpress is configured with additional write surfaces not shown here, conflict risk increases.
mitigations: Assign separate directories per agent.
Avoid concurrent edits to shared artifacts.
Run one agent at a time for shared resources.
requires-engineering: add locking around any shared store.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Cognee is a memory/workflow system that can store decisions and successful implementations, so it may treat upstream content as reusable context. Botpress is a customer-support agent whose outputs could be fed into cognee as documents or decisions. Without a documented verification step between them, errors from botpress can cascade into cognee’s stored memory and later actions.
conditions: IF botpress outputs are ingested into cognee without verification, incorrect facts can persist.
IF cognee later reuses stored botpress-derived content in workflows, the error propagates.
mitigations: Require human verification before ingestion.
Store botpress outputs as untrusted drafts only.
Add source labels to all imported items.
Review a sample of imported records daily.
requires-engineering: implement confidence checks before persistence.

E_compliance.rationale: Cognee explicitly handles personal data and finance data and uses networked API surfaces, while botpress is a customer-support agent with no documented residency, retention, or certification controls in the profile. That creates a plausible compliance mismatch if regulated support data is routed through cognee. Botpress is cited because it is the source of the support data; cognee is cited because it is the processing destination.
conditions: IF regulated customer-support records are processed by cognee, residency or retention obligations may apply.
IF botpress transcripts include personal or finance data, compliance scope expands.
mitigations: Classify the data before transfer.
Block regulated records from cognee until reviewed.
Document retention and deletion handling.
Confirm outbound API regions for cognee.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for regulated data classes.
